states.description: Person wakes up, dresses, and relaxes briefly on the sofa before breakfast.
Person eats breakfast at the dining table and clears the dishes.

triggers: Person sets the empty cup down
Person sits at the table looking ahead idly
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the dishwasher.

next.on: Person walks out of the room

states.description: Person works at the desk using a laptop and notebook, eventually packing up to leave.

triggers: Person sits down at the desk
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it next to the person.
Pick up the book and place it in the designated storage area.

next.on: Person enters the room and closes the door

states.description: Person returns home, puts down bag, and settles onto the sofa.

next.on: Person watches TV while sitting on the sofa

states.description: Person relaxes on the sofa watching TV and drinking beverages.

triggers: Person adjusts their sitting position on the sofa
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it next to the person.

triggers: Person stands up from the sofa
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it next to the person.

states.description: Person cooks dinner, eats at the table, and cleans up.

triggers: Person wipes their mouth with a napkin
rules.action: Pick up the bowl and place it in the dishwasher.

states.description: Person continues relaxing on the sofa watching TV and using phone.

triggers: Person uses a smartphone while sitting on the sofa
Person watches TV while sitting on the sofa
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it next to the person.

states.description: Person prepares for sleep, turns off lights, and reads in bed.

triggers: Person switches on the bedside lamp
Person leans back on the pillow with the book closed
